name: ship
description: Ship API and Angular framework workspace
author: Scott Gibson

scripts.test: pnpm run api:test && pnpm --filter ship-angular test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run api:test:coverage && pnpm --filter ship-angular test:coverage
scripts.test:pack: pnpm run api:build && node scripts/test-pack.mjs && pnpm run test:pack:reproducible
scripts.test:consumer:minimal: pnpm run api:build && node scripts/test-golden-consumer.mjs minimal
scripts.test:consumer:customized: pnpm run api:build && node scripts/test-golden-consumer.mjs customized
scripts.check: pnpm run api:check && pnpm --filter ship-angular lint && pnpm --filter ship-angular format:check
scripts.lint: pnpm run api:lint && pnpm --filter ship-angular lint
scripts.format: pnpm run api:format && pnpm --filter ship-angular format
scripts.format:check: pnpm run api:format:check && pnpm --filter ship-angular format:check
scripts.type-check: pnpm run api:type-check && pnpm --filter ship-angular type-check
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run api:type-check && pnpm run api:test --changed
scripts.verify: pnpm run api:verify && pnpm --filter ship-angular run ci
scripts.ci: pnpm run api:ci && pnpm exec tsx scripts/build-joint-conformance.mjs --out .ship/joint && pnpm --filter ship-angular run ci
scripts.pre-commit: pnpm run verify:fast && pnpm run check:skills
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm --filter ship-angular sync-version && pnpm --filter ship-angular exec prettier --write ../packages/angular/CHANGELOG.md && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.api:type-check: pnpm run api:build && pnpm --filter './packages/*' --filter '!@sixthsummit/ship-angular' --if-present run type-check
scripts.api:ci: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run check:skills && pnpm run api:type-check && pnpm run api:build && pnpm run api:test
scripts.api:verify: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run check:skills && pnpm run api:type-check && pnpm run api:build && pnpm run api:test && pnpm run api:test:coverage && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:parity && pnpm run test:edge && pnpm run test:pack && pnpm run test:consumer:minimal && pnpm run test:consumer:customized && pnpm run docs:build && pnpm run audit:runtime
scripts.test:joint: pnpm run api:build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/build-joint-conformance.mjs --out .ship/joint && pnpm --filter ship-angular test:joint-conformance
scripts.ci:api: pnpm run api:check && pnpm run check:skills && pnpm run api:type-check && pnpm run api:test:coverage && pnpm run test:parity && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts --maxWorkers=4 && pnpm run test:edge && pnpm run test:pack && pnpm run test:consumer:minimal && pnpm run test:consumer:customized && pnpm run audit:runtime
scripts.ci:angular: pnpm run api:build && pnpm exec tsx scripts/build-joint-conformance.mjs --out .ship/joint && pnpm --filter ship-angular run ci
